chapter: Zue Robertson, Bakke family and teachers
title: Zue Robertson's playing and leaving New Orleans with Joe Oliver
summary: Barnes says Zue Robertson was reckoned good and played shows and circuses; he left town with Joe Oliver.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: One thing I'd like to ask you, while you mention his name was Zoo Robinson, was it Zoo Robinson? Yeah, Zoo Robinson. I guess he left here pretty, it must have been a pretty long time ago. Do you remember anything about the way he played or anything about it?
Well Zoo Robinson was supposed to be a good piano player.
Yeah he's going to be good. Because we call him good and I know what the others would call him.
I know Bunk said he thought he was the best he played with.
Well yes, we call him good but I couldn't tell you if it's hot out on the fire. But there are some Zulep here, who's Zulep with the…
He went to a lot of shows at times.
Well yeah he was playing shows.
Circuses and everything of that kind.
Did you say he left here with somebody?
I think he left here with Joe, with Joe Oliver.
Yeah he was with him in Chicago for a while, I know he played with him up there. I don't know if he was…
Because after that, Oro took over you know.
